title: Reflection
objectives: Inspect and invoke members at runtime

sections.markdown: Reflection lets a program inspect and manipulate classes, methods and fields at runtime — even private ones — without knowing them at compile time.

Reflection + annotations power frameworks: Spring's @Autowired/@Component, JUnit discovering @Test methods, Jackson mapping JSON to fields, Hibernate mapping entities. Understanding it demystifies 'magic'.
Overusing reflection in app code — it's slower, breaks compile-time safety, bypasses encapsulation, and can fail under the module system / security managers. Prefer interfaces and direct calls.
Reflective calls are much slower than direct calls (no inlining). Cache Method/Field lookups, or use MethodHandles/code generation in hot paths.
